story_title: The Case of the Natty Nat
author: Donald J. Sobol
video_title: New!! Weekly Sunday Night Mystery: Encyclopedia Brown and The Case of the Natty Nat
description:
A new weekly mystery bedtime story every Sunday night! In tonight story we are introduced to Encyclopedia Brown, the 10-year-old super sleuth boy detective of Idaville and son of the police chief. This episode tells how Encyclopedia Brown came to be the mystery master crime solver of Idaville by solving the Case of the Natty Nat! 

Every story from here on lets you and your children and/or grandchildren try to find the clues and solve the mystery. I will post the previous week's crime solution at the beginning of next week's new Sunday Night Mystery with Encyclopedia Brown.

Encyclopedia Brown, Boy Detective originated in the mid-1960s. This was one of those books I always ordered from the Scholastic Books Service when they were released back when I was in grade school. I learned to love reading, in part, because of these captivating stories.

Chaz
